claves: Blastosporas: esporas asexuales que salen por gemación. Clamidosporas: esporas de resistencia, también asexuales (las esferas más oscuras en la punta de los filamentos).

imagen.fuente: OpenStax Microbiology (23.5 Fungal Infections of the Reproductive System)
imagen.autor: modification of work by Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
imagen.descripcionOriginal: Candida blastospores (asexual spores that result from budding) and chlamydospores (resting spores produced through asexual reproduction) are visible in this micrograph. (credit: modification of work by Centers for Disease Control and Prevention)
